answer_1.quote: We evaluate COLLATE based on the utility of the generated rationales to improve performance of small-scale LLMs on five datasets across three diverse task domains: 1) Maths Word Problem Solving -GSM8K , 2) Natural Language Inference -PIQA and WinoGrande , and 3) Commonsense Reasoning -CSQA and HellaSwag .

answer_2.quote: We evaluate COLLATE and baselines by conducting rationale-conditioned Supervised Fine-Tuning... The accuracy achieved is indicative of usefulness of rationales. Additionally, in Appendix I, perplexity is used to assess rationale quality.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human study to evaluate the rationales generated by the rationale providers... We asked human evaluators to judge if 1) final rationale obtained from COLLATE is correct and helpful, and 2) whether the rationale generated by one of the rationale providers is better than the other and if yes, select the better one.
answer_4.guideline: Human evaluators were asked to judge correctness and helpfulness of rationales, and to compare rationales to select the better one.
